title: Owner: see the first reply come faster after idle, and the memory warning
goal: Owner: see the first reply come faster after idle, and the memory warning
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "ollama a+b, c as option in dashboard".

On the live service after the update the owner follows the copy-paste page written by F-144-T07 (docs/acceptance/owner-steps-<date>.md): (1) `ollama stop gemma4:12b` (or the configured chat model), then send "ciao" in the chat and note the first-reply time; (2) send "ciao" again and note it; (3) `nerv doctor` shows time to first token cold and warm; (4) `ollama ps` shows the model with a long UNTIL time (about 30 minutes; Forever when "keep loaded always" is on); (5) after a restart `ollama ps` shows the model loaded without any chat
The owner decides whether the gain is enough and whether to turn "keep loaded always" on; the agent records the result
privacy: Local Ollama only; test data is neutral and invented; no secrets; warm-up calls carry no user text.
validation: Owner check, recorded in F-144 Verification
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the existing engine-provider, config and dashboard code; one short procedure. Not a measurement.
